description: CARTA publishes a simplified view of its Chattanooga bus and shuttle routes through a GitHub data pipeline. The pipeline reads CARTA’s official GTFS feed and emits a route table in CSV, GeoJSON, JSON and JSON Lines at public S3 addresses. The README lists route id, name, display colour and stroke as fields; its GeoJSON output provides line geometry for mapping. CARTA says the pipeline runs daily, while the underlying GTFS feed changes every several months. The public CSV and GeoJSON addresses answered HTTP 200 during this review, but their bodies were not read, so current feature counts and dates remain unverified. GitHub labels the repository CC0-1.0; the S3 output files do not state a separate licence in the inspected README. The data describe routes, not stop times, frequencies or live vehicle positions. A transport modeller could use the geometries for a high-level network or service-area scenario, then obtain full GTFS for timetables. Related catalogue resource data-gtfs-specification defines the full format that the pipeline simplifies. No download or route-quality test was performed.
